briefing.title: THE KEY
lines: Forty years ago the Meridian Combine walked out of this valley and left one machine running. The Reclaimer. A harvester the size of a district, with one order: reclaim all material.
It is still obeying. It strips the yards to bare earth and hauls everything to the Crucible, where it melts into ingots nobody will ever collect.
Last night you took the Combine's shutdown key off a dead foreman. The Reclaimer felt it go. It follows the key now.
Three free machines. Three yards. Carry the key to the Crucible before it catches you.
briefing.bay_text: Three frames on the lifts and a bench of basic parts. Build the crew that will carry the key.

panels.caption: THE VALLEY
panels.text: The Meridian Combine left this valley forty years ago and left one machine running: a harvester the size of a district that eats every yard down to bare earth. It is the red wall on your map.

panels.caption: THE KEY
panels.text: You took the Combine's shutdown key off a dead foreman. The Reclaimer felt it go. Every few of your moves it takes one more zone of the map (the gauge at the top): keep moving forward.

panels.caption: YOUR CREW
panels.text: A machine IS its parts: a frame, a core, two arms, a module. Arms get torn off, wrecks drop scrap. Win fights for parts, fit them in the GARAGE, repair and upgrade at WORKSHOPS.

panels.caption: THE ROAD
panels.text: Three yards lie between you and the Crucible. Each ends at a GATE held by a boss. Pick your road site by site, break all three gates, and turn the key in the Core.

acts.name: THE CRANE YARDS
acts.mission: Reach the Sorting Gate. The Reclaimer follows the key.
acts.boss: The Sorting Gate, and the Sorter that keeps it, shielded by the gate's pylons. Through it is the next yard.

acts.name: THE SLAG FLATS
acts.mission: Cross the flats to The Pour. The slag is still warm.
acts.boss: The Pour: the Slag Flats' keeper, flooding the floor under the crew. Through it is the Crucible.

arrival.caption: MEANWHILE...
arrival.text: The Sorter is scrap behind you. Ahead are the cooling fields where the Reclaimer pours what it melts. The enemies here are tougher, and so is their salvage.

arrival.caption: NEW HERE
arrival.text: SLAG burns 2 a round to anything standing in it -- never end a move there. SENTINELS are plated and anchored: they do not move, so step off their lines or shove something into them.

arrival.caption: AT THE END
arrival.text: The Pour floods the hexes under your machines every other round, and at half HP it floods every round. Keep moving, and break it before the floor runs out.

acts.name: THE CRUCIBLE
acts.mission: Into the furnace-city. The key goes into the Core.
acts.boss: The Core: the Crucible's heart, bolted to the floor and pulsing. Turn the key in it and the Reclaimer stops.

arrival.caption: MEANWHILE...
arrival.text: The furnace-city. Everything the Reclaimer ever took ends up here, melted into ingots nobody collects -- and this is where the key goes in.

arrival.caption: NEW HERE
arrival.text: FURNACE FLUES blow for 3 every other round -- the board warns a round ahead. CONDUITS make every enemy next to them hit 1 harder: kill them, or pull their friends away.

arrival.caption: AT THE END
arrival.text: The run's last boss. Its two CONDUITS shield it (2 less from every hit): break them first. Stay out of its pulsing ring, and at half HP it pulses every round.

sites.start: The crew's camp. The Reclaimer's dust is already on the horizon.
sites.skirmish: Spiked rigs, working for the Reclaimer. Beat them for scrap and their parts.
sites.elite: A heavy spiked rig and its escort. One of its parts is worth having.
sites.scrapyard: A heap the Reclaimer has not reached. Take one part, or strip it for scrap.
sites.workshop: A Combine service hall with the lights still on. Repairs, rebuilds, part upgrades, room in the hold.
sites.boss: The Sorting Gate, and the Sorter that keeps it, shielded by the gate's pylons. Through it is the next yard.
sites.trader: A free trader in a container, lamps on. Parts for scrap, and scrap for your spares.
sites.tower: A crane cab still standing. From up there the fog is thinner.
sites.signal: Something out here is sending. Worth a look, maybe.
sites.warlord: A Reclaimer warlord holds this ground with its own rule. Its hoard is worth the detour.
sites.refinery: A Combine refinery with one furnace still banked. Feed it a part and something better comes out.
sites.auction: Free machines selling salvage they never opened. You pay first.
sites.arena: A ring of barriers and spiked rigs that fight for the Reclaimer's amusement. Win, and the pot is yours.

endings.won: The key turns in the Core. Behind the crew the Reclaimer's booms sag and go still, one district at a time, and the valley is quiet for the first time in forty years.
endings.gate_held: The gate held. The crew had nothing left to break it with, and the Reclaimer closed in behind.
endings.wrecked: The Reclaimer took the crew. Somewhere in the Crucible, the key melts with them.

sorter.where: The Sorting Gate: the Combine's old checkpoint out of the Crane Yards.
sorter.how: While a gate PYLON stands it takes 3 less from every hit, and every 3 rounds it calls a drone.
sorter.beat: Break the pylons behind it first, then the Sorter.

pour.where: The Pour: where the Reclaimer drains its slag onto the flats.
pour.how: Every other round it floods the hexes your machines stand on; at half HP, every round.
pour.beat: Keep moving off the marked hexes and hit it hard while there is floor.

heart.where: The Core: the Crucible's heart, and the key's lock.
heart.how: Shielded by its two CONDUITS (2 less a hit). It pulses its ring every other round; at half HP, every round.
heart.beat: Break both conduits, stay out of the ring, then break the Core.

grinder.where: A warlord's yard off the road, ringed with saws.
grinder.how: At the start of every round it cuts 2 off each of your machines standing next to it.
grinder.beat: Hit it from range, or strike and step away.

magnet.where: A warlord's lot off the road: the Magnet King's.
magnet.how: Every other round it hauls your machines within 3 a hex toward itself -- into pits, into each other.
magnet.beat: Stand where a haul does no harm, or stay out of its reach.

twin.where: The Twin Furnaces: two warlords, one yard.
twin.how: While both stand, each takes 2 less from every hit.
twin.beat: Focus one until it breaks; then the other has no cover.
